Documentation: Document the implementation details, including any setup instructions or configuration changes required for deployment.5. Training and Support: Provide training and support to the internal team on using and maintaining the real-time update feature.Skills Required:Qualifications:

- Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

- Strong communication skills and ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.Timeline:The project has the potential to lead to long term engagement.Additional Information:This project is a top priority for our team, as it directly impacts the user experience of our CaptureProof platform. We are looking for a skilled and proactive Full Stack Developer who can take ownership of this project and drive it to successful completion.Note:Candidates applying for the Full Stack Developer position will be expected to lead this project as their first task upon joining the team.Company Overview:We are a dynamic and innovative healthcare technology company committed to revolutionizing the way medical professionals collaborate and share patient data. Our flagship product, CaptureProof, provides a secure platform for clinicians to capture, share, and discuss medical images and videos in real-time. With a focus on usability, security, and scalability, we are dedicated to improving patient care and clinical workflows through cutting-edge technology.Position Overview:We are seeking a talented Full Stack Developer to join our team and play a key role in enhancing our CaptureProof web and mobile applications. The successful candidate will be responsible for implementing new features, optimizing performance, and resolving technical challenges across the entire stack. title: American/British English Accent Detection
description:
Project Overview:I am currently developing a Python-based project focused on the detection of accents, with a particular emphasis on distinguishing between American and British accents. This project aims to analyze two types of audio samples: one that exhibits a flawless American accent, which could be either AI-generated or uttered by a native speaker, and another that is recorded by a user. The system is designed to assess how closely the user's accent matches the standard American or British accent they select, specifically in terms of pronunciation accuracy. This assessment is anticipated to be represented as a percentage, indicating the level of similarity.Additionally, I am eager to deepen my understanding of the entire coding and development process behind this project. I am looking forward to learning directly under your guidance, either by working together or through side-by-side instruction in regular meetings. My goal is to thoroughly comprehend every aspect of the project. I am committed to coding alongside you on a regular basis, and I am ready to dedicate as much time as necessary to build this project together, given that there is no strict deadline.Project Requirements:Accent Detection Model: At the heart of this project is the need for a pre-trained model or the development of a new model that is capable of analyzing audio samples for the purpose of accent comparison. This model must be adept at identifying discrepancies in pronunciation and quantifying the similarities in accents.Model Integration or Development: Although I have initiated some groundwork with Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), I am open to the idea of integrating a model from Hugging Face or adopting any other advanced methodology you suggest. The main aim is to ensure that the model can effectively distinguish between accent similarities with a high degree of accuracy.Audio Comparison and Feedback System: The proposed system will allow users to select an American or British accent for comparison. Following this selection, a reference audio clip in the chosen accent will be played. Subsequently, users will be prompted to record their own attempt at mimicking the heard accent. Importantly, the GUI or the command-line interface will offer users the option to listen to their own recorded audio before initiating the comparison process. If they are not satisfied with their recording, they will have the opportunity to re-record themselves. Moreover, users will be able to listen to the AI-generated or native speaker's voice multiple times to ensure they are fully prepared. The model will then compare the user's audio against the reference, providing a similarity score. If the similarity score surpasses 90%, the user will be congratulated. Conversely, if the score falls below 90%, the system will examine the user's pronunciation, marking correctly pronounced words in green and incorrectly pronounced words in red.Interactive User Interface: The application may be equipped with either a Graphical User Interface (GUI) or a command-line interface, enabling users to:
- Choose between an American or British accent for analysis.
- Select sentences from a predefined list to mimic, thereby enriching the learning experience through diverse examples.
- Receive auditory cues for recording prompts, followed by immediate feedback on their pronunciation accuracy.
- Listen to their own recording before proceeding with the comparison, with an option to re-record if necessary.
- Repeatedly listen to the reference audio to better understand the target accent.Technical Specifications: This project entails the application of CNNs, the utilization of pre-trained models, or the creation of a bespoke model specifically designed for accent analysis. It is imperative that the system can efficiently conduct audio comparisons, offering users valuable feedback on their pronunciation proficiency in relation to the chosen accent.

title:
Need help with building a growth forecast model for the outbound
channel
description:
Outbound has grown to be our #1 revenue driver at our startup and we must model it right. We identified companies in our TAM and the right contacts to contact via email. We send them highly personalized sequences with the goal of generating demos.Based on the following assumptions, this case study aims to build a model to predict the New ARR per month generated from the outbound channel.We need to answer the following questions:
- How many demos can we generate with Outbound?
- How much can we expect to close from Outbound?Expected output: model in your favorite software: Excel, Spreadsheet, Causal, etc.
- Number of demos booked from Outbound per month
- New ARR closed from Outbound per monthAssumptions
- Outbound channel start date: Jan 2024- Total companies in the TAM: 100,000- Full email volume capacity per month: 120,000- Minimum number of contacts to email per company: 3- Number of emails per sequence: 4- Unsubscribe rate: 1% by sequence(Hint: start by calculating how many companies you can touch per month with your email volume capacity)Total number of sequences before giving up on a company: 4- Cumulative interest rate after these four sequences:(A sequence is sent to a company every two months)
- Month 0: 2%- Month 2: 4%- Month 4: 6%- Month 6: 8%Hint: based on your first cohort of companies first emailed, model the volume of companies touched at sequence #2, #3, and #4 - with their appropriate incremental interest rate to get the total volume of demos per month)
- Close rate: 20% (intra-month closing)
- Deal Size: $10KDefinition:
- Interest rate = Company booking a demo / Company touched via email - Cumulative interest rate: This means if I email 100 companies inJanuary, two will book a demo in January, another two will book a demo in March, another two in May, and another two in July - 7 months after, 8 out of this 100 companies will have secured a demo
- Close rate = Company subscribing to Polar Analytics / Company booking a demo
- Sequence = Suite of 4 emails to be sent to a company in a given month.
- Email volume capacity = How many emails can we send in a given month
- Outbound channel start date = The month where we will contact the firstcompanies for their first sequenceNote : I would need the output with Growth model in Google sheets

title: Deploy and Customize OpenDAX
description:
Set up a digital asset exchange with OpenDAX, configuring wallets, deposits, purchasing of digital assets, and customizing for Digital Assets with Escrow (DAE):Setting Up OpenDAX1. Environment Setup:
- Install prerequisites: Docker, Docker Compose, Ruby, Rails.
- Clone the OpenDAX repository from GitHub.2. Exchange Configuration:
- Update `config/app.yml` with exchange details.
- Set currencies, markets, and trading pairs in `config/seed/currencies.yml`, `config/seed/markets.yml`, and `config/seed/trading_pairs.yml`.3. Database Setup:
- Initialize the database and load seed data.
- Configure settings in `config/database.yml`.4. Wallet Integration:
- Set up wallet services for supported cryptocurrencies.
- Configure wallet settings in `config/seed/wallets.yml`.5. User Interface Customization:
- Modify front-end components for branding and design.
- Use React components and CSS for customization.6. Exchange Deployment:
- Use Docker Compose to deploy services.
- Test functionality and ensure all services are running correctly.7. Security Implementation:
- Set up SSL certificates and two-factor authentication (2FA).
- Regularly update software for security patches.8. Launch and Monitoring:
- Open exchange to the public and onboard users.
- Monitor performance, security, and user activity.Configuring Wallets and Trading1. User Registration and Wallet Creation:
- Users sign up and automatically get a wallet for each supported cryptocurrency.2. Depositing Money:
- Integrate a payment gateway for fiat currency deposits.- (Note: Cryptocurrency deposits are not supported in this setup.)3. Purchasing Digital Assets:
- Users place buy orders for digital assets.
- The matching engine executes trades, and assets are transferred to the user's wallet.Customizing for Digital Assets with Escrow (DAE)1. Define DAE as a Tradable Asset:
- Add DAE as an asset in `config/seed/currencies.yml`.
- Create a market pairing DAE with USD in `config/seed/markets.yml`.2. Modify the Trading Interface:
- Customize the UI to accommodate DAE trading.
- Implement order placement for DAE.3. Implement Escrow Mechanism:
- Modify the matching logic to move funds to an escrow account for DAE orders.
- Develop a mechanism for escrow release once the DAE is confirmed as released.Considerations
- Ensure robust security measures are in place, especially for escrow transactions.
- Thoroughly test the modified trading engine and escrow mechanism.

Layer 2 SolutionsObjective: Achieve scalability and high throughput for smart contract execution using Layer 2 solutions such as zkRollups.Connectivity:Layer 2 Integration: Layer 2 solutions are integrated with Quantum Chain nodes for off-chain transaction processing while maintaining security and decentralization.Deployment and Launch PhasesThe implementation and launch of Quantum Chain and Quantum Coin follow a systematic approach:Quantum Chain Development: Customize the Ethereum fork for Quantum Chain and integrate quantum resistance features, Chainlink, AWS infrastructure, Polygon bridge, and Layer 2 solutions.Quantum Coin Development: Develop Quantum Coin ($Q) following Ethereum token standards with quantum resistance features.Token Distribution: Execute the ICO, allocate tokens, and implement vesting schedules.Integration: Integrate Quantum Coin into the Quantum Chain ecosystem for various purposes, including transaction fees, staking, governance, and rewards.Testing: Thoroughly test Quantum Chain and Quantum Coin for security, scalability, and compatibility.Launch: Deploy Quantum Chain mainnet and Quantum Coin ($Q) to the public.Upon successful completion of the project and launch of the Quantum Chain and Quantum ($Q) Coin.Please apply with your cv. Assess current infrastructure and integration requirements.2. Design an architecture for the Mirth environment, including server specifications and network configurations.3. Customize message transformers, filters, and JavaScript code as needed.6. Implement secure communication protocols (e.g., SSL/TLS) for data transmission.7. Conduct unit testing and integration testing of Mirth channels.8. Document configurations, workflows, and troubleshooting procedures.9. Provide knowledge transfer sessions and training to IT staff as necessary.10. Deliverables must be provided in a timely manner and in accordance with project timelines.Proposal Requirements: Interested vendors are requested to submit a comprehensive proposal that includes the following:1. Overview of the vendor's experience with Mirth Connect and healthcare IT integration projects.2. Proposed approach and methodology for setting up the Mirth environment.3. Detailed project plan with timelines, milestones, and deliverables.4. Cost estimate, including itemized pricing for software licenses, hardware procurement, installation, configuration, and any additional services.5. Information about the vendor's technical expertise, certifications, and qualifications.6. References from previous clients for similar projects.Proposal Submission: Proposals must be submitted electronically no later than TBD to David Andrews and Fletcher Watson at [email removed] and [email removed] Late submissions will not be considered.Evaluation Criteria: Proposals will be evaluated based on the following criteria:1. Experience and expertise in Mirth Connect implementation and healthcare IT integration.2. Clarity and comprehensiveness of the proposed approach and methodology.3. Alignment with project objectives and requirements.4. Cost-effectiveness and value proposition.5. References and track record of successful project delivery.Selection Process: After reviewing all proposals, Purity Health may conduct interviews or request additional information from shortlisted vendors. The final selection will be based on the evaluation criteria and overall fit with our organization's needs and goals.Disclaimer: This RFP does not constitute a contractual commitment. Purity Health reserves the right to reject any or all proposals received in response to this solicitation or to cancel the solicitation at any time.Thank you for your interest in partnering with Purity Health on this important project. We look forward to receiving your proposal.

- This project will run at the beginning only on the crypto market. The idea is really simple, we can create some strategies, and for each strategy, we declare an amount of required indicators. Based on these indicators, we can use a generator to generate all of the combinations of indicator settings that are possible for this strategy and that will be named as a Runtime.
- This runtime runs starting a specific date, and from that, will start to backtest by running from the historical data until we arrive at the current time. When we arrive at the current time, the process runs live.OUR PROCESS:
- I will provide you: more details of project explanation, a roadmap of each milestone, the test files for each milestone, an inspiration for the database structures and the first strategies which will need to be implemented and work at the end.

title: Figma to Wordpress with Open AI integration
description:
We have a simple Figma design for a small webapp that is to be integrated into an existing wordpress page and integrated with our Open AI API. You can view the Figma here:https://www.figma.com/file/zRfiP3zA62LF93ZUEpK70i/ME-KIBA?type=design&node-id=0%3A1&mode=design&t=Xg6x9SmBgeYUKZbE-1What the web app does: The web app as visualized in Figma is meant as a landing page for business partners who agreed to review a service that has been provided to them. They will be offered assistance in writing their review via an AI-Text-Assistant (AITA). If they opt for the assistant, they will be asked which areas of the service provided they liked best and want to see mentioned in the review. These can be selected. Then the AITA will compose the review (via Open AI API) and present the result on the next page. This result can be copied to the clipboard by the user, so it can be used when placing the actual review on Google or Proven Experts (a review portal).The Figma: The design in figma was done in a simple manner. No components have been defined, no Auto-Layout, etc. However, the web app is very simple and consits only of four pages / steps.Responsiveness: The current design is meant for a mobile view and we would like to stick to that design in desktop and tablet view by making it appear like a form. Example:https://s38924.pcdn.co/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/ftl-contact-form.jpgOn the smartphone, the header and footer of the wordpress page will need to be hidden from view, so that only the web app becomes visible.On desktop and tablet, the web app will appear like a form of the wordpress page.The Open AI integration: We already have a successful integration in place via Gravity Forms and their Open AI plugin. This could be used if you can make it work with the design.If you chose to use the existing Gravity Forms integration, the main challenge seems to get the result from the Open AI query to show up in our properly designed "page 3" instead of the Gravity Forms notification page (this is how it works out of the box after clicking submit).If you do not want to use Gravity Forms, we could run our own python script (which we would provide you) or use a different plugin.Page 2 functionality: We will need to be able to add or remove the selectable options in the Wordpress backend. We may want to add "Great customer support" some time in the future or remove an option. The selectable boxes must either be flexibly arrange themselves a) in the lenght of each box according to text displayed and b) to minimize white space between boxes. Alternatively, we can also live with a different design option as long as it looks good.Page 3 functionality: In the Figma, the result shows in a scrollable text box. The user should be able to edit the text here, if he likes. The button "Copy to Clipboard" should do just that.General:
- The web app should work on most of todays devices and browsers.
- The "form entries" should be collected with the review generated AND with the review that was present when the user clicks "Next". This way we can analyze if the user modified the proposed text.Timeline: We would like to complete this project as soon as possible, preferably until the 23rd of February at the latest.Please do not send AI-generated project proposals :)Thank you and I am looking forward to e-meeting you.

title: Modify Roundcube Webmail to simplify alias by plugin custom_from
description: Improve and fix the Custom_from plugin https://github.com/r3c/custom_from that enables a virtual email sender input for FOSS https://github.com/roundcube/roundcubemail . Also check if its possible to allow editing the email address's local-part in Roundcube natively.1) The plugin's default reply setting is to write from the custom email address but not the regular identity. Although this can be switched in the plugin's settings, it does not work for a multi-user setup of webhosting companies as some clients wish to reply from the custom email address which is the current default setting while others want to reply from their regular identity/address. This means, there needs to be a toggle in Roundcube's settings to choose one or the other option.→ Can this option be added to Roundcube's UI settings when adding the plugin?→ An even better solution may be to integrate half of the functionality in Roundcube natively by making the local-part of the email address editable. A toggle option in the settings shall determine to either always reply with the default identity or with the custom local-part the email was sent to before is got forwarded to the mailbox (as long as the domain-part is the same. Otherwise, it would require the custom_from plugin for a totally virtual alias). This saves setting up several identities for each custom email address the user receives emails to.The benefit is to communicate with each service provider by an individual email address so when the personal email address is leaked, it can easily be blocked by filtering as the main mailbox remains unknown which is a great spam protection.2) The plugin loses the modified email address and switched back to the user's default identity when saving a draft, closing the editing window and reopening the draft.→ Can this be fixed?You would need to set up a Roundcube installation and test the changes before creating a pull request on GitHub.Also modify the plugin's (and i.a. Roundcube's) ReadMe instructions accordingly and include sample pictures so that people have a visual impression of the functionality.As this will not only help myself but become public domain, it is a voluntary job that I'm happy to kick-start with a small budget.Send me a proposal when you wanna fight spam and consider the above useful and yourself skilled for the job.

- API integrations with credit bureaus and financial institutions for real-time data fetching and analysis.
- Secure and compliant data handling processes to ensure client information is protected.3. **Pre-Qualifying/Preapproval Tools:**- Implementation of a soft credit pull feature to offer pre-approval options without affecting clients' credit scores.
- Customizable calculators and tools to help clients assess their eligibility and potential funding amounts.
- Real-time feedback and suggestions for improving creditworthiness and funding options.4. **Client Dashboard:**- Personalized dashboards for clients to view their application status, funding options, educational content, and progress tracking.
- Notifications and alerts system for application updates, required actions, and relevant offers.5. **Educational Resources:**- A comprehensive resource center with articles, videos, and guides on business credit, funding strategies, and financial management.
- Interactive webinars and workshops signup feature.6. **Integration with CRM and Other Business Tools:**- Seamless integration with popular CRM systems for efficient client management.
- Connection with accounting software for easy financial analysis and documentation.7. **SEO and Content Marketing Tools:**- Blog and content management system for SEO-optimized articles and updates.
- Integration of social media sharing tools and newsletter signup for marketing purposes.8. **Security Features:**- Implementation of SSL certificates, two-factor authentication, and other security measures.
- Compliance with financial regulations and data protection laws.**Design and User Experience:**- The design should be modern, clean, and professional, emphasizing ease of use and accessibility.
- Mobile-responsive design to ensure functionality across all devices and browsers.
- High-quality graphics and interactive elements to engage users and provide a visual representation of products and services.**Technical Specifications:**- Development using scalable and secure web technologies (e.g., HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript frameworks).
- Cloud hosting for reliability and scalability.
- Implementation of analytics tools for tracking user engagement and conversion rates.**Timeline and Milestones:**- Detailed timeline with milestones for the design, development, testing, and launch phases.
- Regular updates and review meetings to ensure the project remains on track and aligned with business goals.**Budget and Resources:**- An outline of the budget for the project, including development, design, and ongoing maintenance costs.
- Resources available, including access to existing content, brand guidelines, and any third-party tools or services to be integrated.This description provides a foundational blueprint for your web developer to understand your vision, goals, and the technical and design requirements of your business credit funding website. It's important to maintain open and regular communication with your developer throughout the project to ensure alignment with your objectives and to make necessary adjustments based on feedback and testing.

title: WordPress Plugin Development for Backlinks
description: Looking to develop a Backlink Network plugin.When installed, it will create a dashboard for the user. The dashboard will contain a number of tabs.1. 1st tab will display a list of all pages/posts on the WordPress site. It will contain Page Title, Keyword Focus from Yoast and URL. It will also show how many backlinks have been added to this URL from the backlink network.2. 2nd tab will contain Inventory of Pages/Posts in the Network inventory.3. Each WordPress site will gain backlink credits. When installed they will receive 2 free credits. This will be displayed at the top of the dashboard.4. The website owner will review the Network Inventory and select a keyword + URL, then manually add to a page/post. Once added, they will return to the inventory + submit for review by providing the URL where the link was added.5. The plugin will verify the link exists and then send backlink details (URL + keyword) to Network Inventory.6. The network inventory database will have a backlink record for each URL and then update the backlink count on the inventory.7. When a site receives a backlink the dashboard will display a backlink count on the Site Page/Post in the 1st tab above.8. For every 2 backlinks added, the website will earn 1 backlink credit to be used in the 1st tab above.9. From the 1st tab, the user will select Pages/Posts to be displayed in the network inventory based on the number of backlink credits available. To start each user will receive 2 free credits. Each time they add 2 backlinks they will earn 1 more credit.10. A user can remove backlinks from their site, this will adjust their link credits and auto adjust which posts/pages display in the network inventory. This should be rescanned daily.11. If a user does not want to earn backlink credits, they can purchase.12. User can change which Pages/Posts they wish to include in the inventory at any time by selecting/unselecting from 1st tab even if they have received backlinks.13. To earn credits, a maximum of 3 backlinks will be allowed per URL. When scanning URL for backlinks to verify credits it should be based on a date the backlink was added. Therefore oldest backlinks should be counted 1st, any new links will not be counted after 3/URL.14. Backlinks added will required rel=dofollow to be counted for credit. When re-scanning backlinks daily, it should monitor for valid parameters.Will need the plugin maintained over time and help submitting to WordPress plugin directory. The initial plugin will not offer option to buy credits, we will add this in the future.

title: Ambitious Junior Web3.0 Dev with Go or JavaScript Experience
description:
Globe & Citizen Web3.0 Job Posting# WHAT:Welcome to Globe & Citizen! An international startup seeking to become Web3.0's premier distributed news network. Our company is based around 3 projects:- "Celebrity Fanalyzer" (to be rebranded as "Globe & Citizen: News of Our World" in 2025)
- Layer8 (A browser based end-to-end-encryption proxy)
- Crypto Native Corporation Portal (A web portal for creating Crypto Native Corporations)What is a Crypto Native Corporation (CNC)? A CNC is a company that has an analogous structure to any corporation except that it can be, from the very beginning, globally distributed because it uses crypto as it’s primary medium of economic exchange and governance (see the attached extended explanation, “What_and_Why_of_CNCs.docx”).# WHY:To improve our world and get rich while we do it.# WHO:1 – 4 junior web3 developers with big ambitions! The ideal candidate will be very ambitious and not afraid to learn! Currently the team is comprised of 6 developers and 4 auxiliary members. Spread around the world in Nigeria, Singapore, Venezuela, Pakistan, Uzbekistan, Togo, Brazil, and Canada.# WHERE:Fully remote. You will meet with your team lead for one on ones weekly and join a weekly team meeting. In addition, you will meet with me (the Chief Policy Officer & financier) at least monthly. Ad hoc meetings are also encouraged. All financial transactions will be done through UpWork. We communite using Discord as well and you will upload all your work to one of Globe & Citizen’s Github repos.# PROJECT SUMMARIES:## “Globe & Citizen: News of Our World”Globe & Citizen is dedicated to sanitizing user data so that the anonymized aggregate can be publicly analyzed so that users can decided their own truth about world events. In order to accomplish this, you will complete development of https://celebrityfanalyzer.com/ which is actually Globe & Citizen in stealth mode (see the attached). Your will:
- Converting Celebrity Fanalyzer into a DAPP so that the monthly competitions can be run using Ethereum instead of fiat currency (what we have been doing).
- Experimenting with how anonymized data can be analyzed and then reflected back to users.
- Optimizing. Celebrity Fanalyzer is a Progressive Web App built using Quasar and VueJS## “Layer8: A Browser Based E2E Encryption Proxy”Built using Golang compiled to WASM, Layer8 routes http traffic through a custom server that strips identifying headers before sending the encrypted payload on to a service provider. This has the effect of separating your true identity from your content choices online. Once sanitized, user data can then be aggregated for public analysis and presentation by a service provider.## “Crypto Native Corporation Portal (CNC Portal)”Our goal in 2024 is to complete development of our MVP (Celebrity Fanalyzer + Layer8) while pretending to be 3 different companies entering into smart contracts with each other. Governance and finance for these three pretend “companies” will be done using the CNC Portal that YOU will build using the attached mocks as a guide.The CNC is to be what Github is to Git for anyone wanting to build open source. In short, though a centralized platform is planned, it will facilitate decentralized companies spread around the globe and this is our vision. Why a centralized platform? Because, in the words of Signals founder, “We should accept the premise that people will not run their own servers by designing systems that can distribute trust without having to distribute infrastructure. This means architecture that anticipates and accepts the inevitable outcome of relatively centralized client/server relationships, but uses cryptography (rather than infrastructure) to distribute trust.”# WHY SHOULD I JOIN GLOBE AND CITIZEN?We are an early stage company and your primary task will be to iterate on functionality. This is the most exciting part of software development because it is functionality that defines a product in the minds of users! We are also sustainably self funded which means that we put a premium on the learning and development of our people. We hope you will learn, experiment and bring forward your ideas!# HOW TO APPLYTo begin with, you will join either team Globe&Citizen or team CNC Portal (thougheventually you are like to participate in all projects).1) Apply to this post -- see the 4 questions2) Attend a 1 hour interview.# ABOUT THE COMPANY:Globe & Citizen first came into being October 2022 when the first hires joined on Upwork (all of whom are still with the company 16 months later!) It’s a worker driven company seeking to pioneer a fully remote, globally distributed, business model.# REQUIREMENTS:English. A robust Internet connection. Relevant development experience. And, again, be ready to learn, and learn, and learn. You will joing to work AND push yourslef to develop professionally.

title: C++ Task: Pipelined RISC-V CPU Simulator
description: **Description**:In this project, you will design a RISC-V 5-stage pipelined processor usingC++.The ISA of this processor is the standard RV32-I base extension.The provided source code contains an incomplete implementation of the CPU.The processor implementation consists of two parts:* The CPU emulator: decode and execute instructions to generate instruction trace.* The CPU simulator: Use the instruction trace to perform cycle-level simulation.You are responsible for completing the code of the emulator and simulator such that you can successfully execute the provided tests on the processor.The project is divided into 3 parts:## Part 1 : DecodeIn this part, you will complete the implementation of the emulator decode logic.Refer to **TODO** entries inside decode.cpp for where you may make your changes## Part 2 : ExecuteIn this part, you will complete the implementation of the emulator execute logic.Refer to **TODO** entries inside execute.cpp for where you may make your changes## Part 3 : Timing SimulationIn this part, you will complete the implementation of the simulator logic.You need to resolve data and control hazards correctly inside the simulator such that the resulting timing is accurate.* Resolving data hazard: You will simulate data forwarding support in the timing simulator by stalling the pipeline for the case(s) where data forwarding is not possible.* Resolving control hazard: You will simply stall the pipeline when you encounter a control hazard.

title: Google Sheets Projected Revenue Mapping
description: Hey there - I'm looking for some help with data. I need it done within 3 hours though so ONLY take this on if you can do it. Here's the brief.I run facebook and google adverts for a charity. I need help created a forecast sheet for the next 5 years. I have numbers on CPA, average order value recurring purchases, average order value one-time purchases, % split between one-time and recurring purchases, retention % for recurring too. Recurring meanings a monthly subscription - a direct debit each month that is donated to the charity.What I wanted to find out is how much money we can expect to make over the next 5 years on a monthly basis. Below are the KPIs that I want to know per month for 2024, 2025, 2026 and 2027:Number of DonorsNumber of One-Time DonorsNumber of Recurring DonorsMonthly Donors after retentionMonthly/One-off SplitOne-Off AOVMonthly AOVOne-off IncomeMonthly IncomeTotal IncomeLTVProfit without LTVProfit with LTVCerealBox FeeProfit after CB Fee (with LTV)Here is a template I created that you may wish to follow - https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1zKTsT56Eg3lQOXJ2sn-GiLSpf2h7jKESEMpPRcV56wg/edit?usp=sharingAlso its worth noting that for recurring monthly donations, these accumulate and build over time For recurring you need to add the previous months number with the new acquisition for this month. For example in january if you acquired 10 donors and in February you got 7 then in February you would do 10+7 =17. Your number would be 17. Now in March you get 5 new monthly acquisitions your new total is 17+5 = 22. This is because the recurring donations are set up to be donated each month so each month the total number of recurring donations keep going up.

technical concepts clearly and effectively.Prior experience in AI model integration with software applications is highly desirable.Application Process:Interested candidates are invited to submit a proposal that includes:A summary of your experience with AI/ML projects, particularly those involving NLP and custom GPT models.Your proposed approach for developing a trivia question generation model title: Node.js sandbox
description:
Hi there -I'm looking for a javascript pro to put together a bare-bones node.js express app that gives the user a code sandbox using StackBlitz WebContainers.You can read more about WebContainers here:https://webcontainers.io/guides/introductionIt is a browser based runtime that allows the running of a node application in the browser (all local).Basically, this is a project to set up their hello-world example, but using plain javascript (not Vite), and with one extra feature (file upload)What is a code sandbox? It's:1. Code entry: A textarea where the user can write code2. Output: An output window where the results of the code run are shown (error or successful output)3. File upload: A file upload button that allows the user to upload files to the sandbox, so that they're accessible to the code that was pasted into the code-entry boxI'm attaching a wireframe so that you can see how it works.There's not much that's complicated here - just following the StackBlitz tutorial.The deliverable is:
- A node express app that displays the sandbox UI- A route that uploads files to the WebContainer
- A route that runs code Posted by the user, which includes
- Installing npm libs specified in the user's code
- A method for the user to access files that were uploaded in their code snippet (just a path convention)
- Outputs the results to the output boxThat's it. Should be fun! WebContainers are awesome.

title: Implement a multi-tail queue backed by SQLite database in Java
description: This is not a learning task! It's an isolated fragment of a real code that will be used in production on multiple devices.You need to implement a "multi-tailed" queue as this:- there are many queues identical in everything but their tail position.- "add" operation changes head of all queues- "poll" operation gets and removes element from the tail of a single queue.- no other changes are possible.- code must be thread-safe, and modifying operations must be atomic.Queues may be really long, and should persist between application invocations. So, they aren't stored in memory but in DB, namely SQLite, using xerial SQLite-JDBC bindings.Item in queue should only be inserted to DB once, not duplicated as many times as there are queues.Deliverables:- an implementation of SqliteStorage class- a set of automated tests that checks this implementation- a SQLite database scheme (although it also should be included in java code to create database if it doesn't exist).Please check code attached and feel free to ask me any questions.

title: Data Analysis for Human Activity Recognition Thesis
description: Thank you for your willingness to assist with my project. To ensure you're off to a solid start, I wanted to clarify a few points.I'm currently finalizing my Bachelor's thesis, having completed a thorough introduction and literature review, which I'll share in an attached file. You're not required to read it in full, but here's a summary of the literature review's conclusion: The integration of wearable and ambient sensors in Human Activity Recognition (HAR) shows promise, yet the full potential of their combined use remains largely untapped. The existing research underscores the unique contributions of both sensor types to HAR, suggesting a more comprehensive approach could significantly enhance system accuracy and applicability. – My research question is: How does the performance of HAR methods vary when utilizing data from wearable sensors compared to stationary environmental sensors, and how can these methods be integrated to enhance one another?Your task involves analyzing the OPPURTINITY dataset featuring both ambient and wearable sensors, with the aim of determining how they can be synergistically used for activity detection. Start by evaluating the wearable sensors' accuracy independently, then assess the impact of integrating both types of sensors on accuracy. This analysis will inform our understanding of how to merge these sensors for superior HAR performance. The dataset is labeled with specific activities, allowing for precise accuracy measurements of the HAR system.Please read the dataset description very closely here: https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/226/opportunity+activity+recognitionFeel free to utilize models from existing research, and please avoid designing new models yourself. This will take way too much time. Here are some resources you might find useful:- https://github.com/yashbhagat3/Human-Activity-Recognition-using-LSTMs-Opportunity-UCI-Dataset-- https://link.springer.com/article/10.1186/s[phone removed]- https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/jindongwang92/crossposition-activity-recognitionEnsure all references are correctly cited, and aim for simplicity in your analysis. I'll also send you some example theses for format guidance. It should be concise and to the point.I've included a file from a previous attempt at this analysis for your reference. While it didn't align with my expectations, there might be aspects of it you could find useful. I'm interested in your thoughts on this prior work. Specifically, it lacked precision; it offered a general overview rather than detailing the specific approach he was going to take. For example, rather than a broad statement like:"Low-pass filtering techniques are commonly applied to the raw sensor data to remove high-frequency noise while preserving essential signals related to human movement."I'm looking for a more direct explanation, such as:" Method X has been applied to process the sensor data..."Additionally, the content needs to be more focused. His attempt included too much information irrelevant to the methodology section, which would have been better suited for the introduction or literature review (which I had already made). Please ensure your analysis succinct and relevant, clearly outlining how you conducted it without unnecessary elaboration.I have attached a file of an example thesis. The example thesis provided is for reference on the writing style of the methodology and results sections, even though it covers a different topic. This is the kind of format and approach I envision for my own thesis eventually.I'd like you to concentrate specifically on the data analysis. After completing your analysis, please provide a detailed account of the methods you employed.Given the time already been wasted, a fast completion would be greatly appreciated and rewarded! Thank you so much for your help.If your interested in this job, please send me a plan on how you are going to tackle this, specifically.

title: AI and ML Based Face Detection (Without Obstacles) and Liveness Recognition.
description: Objective: Develop a robust, real-time face detection and liveness detection system to prevent spoofing attacks, such as replay and print attacks.Milestone 1: Face Detection and Visibility Check1. Face Detection APIInput: Real-time video frame.Output: Coordinates of detected faces within the frame (e.g., bounding box coordinates).Technology: Use efficient, lightweight models like MTCNN or MobileNet optimized for real-time processing, targeting at least 10-15 frames per second (fps) on the target hardware.Requirements:The model must accurately detect faces under various lighting conditions and orientations.Include evaluation metrics (accuracy, precision, recall) on a validation dataset.2. Visibility Check APIInput: Video stream.Output: Binary output (1 if the face is clearly visible, else 0).Technology: Implement lightweight models that can assess visibility by evaluating the clarity and visibility of key facial features (eyes, nose, mouth).Requirements:The system should account for occlusions, lighting variations, and blurriness.Provide thresholds or criteria used for determining visibility.3. Backend ArchitectureDesign: Utilize a microservices architecture for modularity, scalability, and reliability. PM2 should be used for process management to ensure uptime and efficient resource use.Implementation: RESTful APIs for communication between the face detection service, visibility check service, and any other microservices developed as part of the system.Requirements:Document API endpoints, request/response formats, and error handling.Ensure APIs support concurrent processing to handle real-time video streams effectively.Milestone 2: Face Liveness Detection1. Replay Attacks DetectionObjective: Detect faces shown on digital devices (mobile phones, LEDs, monitors) to prevent screen-in-screen attacks.Approach: Use texture analysis, motion inconsistency detection, or other relevant techniques that can differentiate between a live face and one displayed on a screen.Integration: Seamlessly integrate with the face detection API to further analyze detected faces for liveness.2. Print Attacks DetectionObjective: Identify attempts to spoof the system using photographs printed on paper.Approach: Implement methods focusing on analyzing the flatness, lack of depth, or texture characteristics that distinguish paper from a live face.Integration: Work in conjunction with the face detection and visibility check APIs to provide a comprehensive security measure.3. Comprehensive Liveness CheckIntegration: Combine the outcomes of face detection, visibility check, and liveness detection (replay and print attack detection) to authenticate live individuals accurately.Requirements:Define how the results from each component are aggregated to make a final decision.Include fallback mechanisms or manual verification options in cases of uncertainty.Additional RequirementsData Management: Provide guidance on collecting and labeling new data for training and validation purposes.Model Training: Detailed instructions for retraining models with new data, including required software, hardware specifications, and command-line instructions.Continuous Learning: Strategies for incorporating continuous learning and improvement into the system based on new data or emerging spoofing techniques.Documentation and SupportDocumentation: Comprehensive documentation covering system architecture, API usage, model training, and integration steps.Support: initial deploying the system on AWS, training models with new data, and troubleshooting common issues.Evaluation and TestingTesting Framework: Develop a testing framework to evaluate the system's performance under various conditions, including different attack scenarios.Performance Metrics: Define and measure key performance metrics such as accuracy, false acceptance rate (FAR), false rejection rate (FRR), and processing time.

title: Optimization and Deployment of AI News Analysis Web App
description: IntroductionWe have developed an AI News Analysis web app that leverages Python for its development. The application integrates Bing News and Search API, as well as the OpenAI API, to enhance user input queries. The primary objective of this web application is to provide users with immediate answers to their queries through news and web search. The application consists of three main components, all of which utilize both the OpenAI and Bing APIs.Current challenges:Our current challenge is that the application code is not optimized, contains many unused libraries,and the code not the best which results in a larger Docker image. This issue hinders our ability to deploy our API on AWS Lambda functions.ObjectiveThe main goal is to rewrite the application code from scratch for optimization & enhancement, develop an API for the existing functions using FastAPI, and deploy the optimized application on AWS Lambda functions. This will ensure that the application is efficient, scalable, and meets the deployment requirements of AWS Lambda.Scope of Work1. Code Analysis• Objective: Study and understand the current codebase to extract the necessary logic and functionalities.• Tasks:• Review the existing web app's codebase.• Identify key functionalities, algorithms, and logic used in the application.• Document the core components and their interactions.2. Code Rewrite• Objective: Rewrite the application code from scratch using the documented logic and functionalities as a reference, ensuring optimization and efficiency.• Tasks:• Develop a clean, optimized codebase using Python, focusing on minimizing dependencies and removing unused libraries.• Ensure the new codebase adheres to best practices for scalability, maintainability, and performance.• Incorporate Bing News and Search API and OpenAI API integrations as per the existing logic.3. FastAPI Development• Objective: Develop a FastAPI-based API for all the application functions to facilitate easy integration and scalability.• Tasks:• Design and implement API endpoints for each functionality of the web app.• Ensure comprehensive API documentation for ease of use and integration.• Implement authentication and authorization mechanisms to secure API access.4. Deployment on AWS Lambda• Objective: Deploy the optimized application on AWS Lambda functions, ensuring that the deployment is efficient and the application is scalable.• Tasks:• Containerize the FastAPI application using Docker, ensuring the Docker image is optimized for size and performance.• Set up the AWS Lambda environment and configure it to host the Docker container.• Implement CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment of the application.Deliverables• A fully rewritten and optimized codebase for the AI News Analysis web app.• A fully functional FastAPI API for the web app's functionalities.• Documentation covering the API endpoints, usage, and integration guide.• A deployed and functional version of the application on AWS Lambda.Project TimelineThe project is expected to be completed within TWO WEEKS, from the commencement date. A detailed timeline will be provided upon project initiation, outlining key milestones and deadlines.ConclusionThis project aims to significantly improve the performance, scalability, and deployment capabilities of the AI News Analysis web app. By rewriting the application code from scratch, developing a FastAPI API, and deploying the application on AWS Lambda, we aim to provide a robust solution that meets the immediate and future needs of our users.

title: World Coin Off-Ramp Integration with M-Pesa
description:
1. Introduction:
- This document outlines the requirements for developing a software solution that facilitates the conversion of World Coin to Kenyan Shillings (KES) using M-Pesa as the payment gateway. The system aims to provide a seamless off-ramp for users to cash out their World Coin holdings into KES.2. Functional Requirements:2.1 User Registration and Authentication:
- Users should be able to register accounts securely on the platform.
- Authentication mechanisms should be implemented to ensure user identity verification.2.2 World Coin Deposit:
- Users should have the ability to deposit World Coin into their accounts on the platform.
- The system should generate unique deposit addresses for each user.2.3 M-Pesa Integration:
- Integration with M-Pesa API to facilitate the transfer of KES to users' M-Pesa accounts.
- Users should be able to link their M-Pesa accounts to the platform for seamless transactions.2.4 Currency Conversion:
- Implement real-time currency conversion from World Coin to KES based on prevailing exchange rates.
- Ensure transparency in conversion fees and rates.2.5 Automated Transaction Processing:
- Develop an automated system for processing transactions, minimizing manual intervention.
- The system should calculate and deduct platform commission fees automatically.2.6 Admin Panel:
- Provide an admin panel for managing user accounts, transactions, and commission rates.
- Admins should have the ability to adjust commission rates and other variables as needed.3. Non-Functional Requirements:3.1 Security:
- Implement robust security measures to protect user data and transactions.
- Use encryption protocols to secure sensitive information.3.2 Scalability:
- Design the system to handle a large volume of transactions and users as the platform grows.
- Ensure scalability by utilizing cloud-based infrastructure and scalable architecture.3.3 Reliability:
- The system should be highly reliable, minimizing downtime and ensuring continuous availability.
- Implement monitoring tools to detect and address any issues promptly.3.4 Performance:
- Ensure fast transaction processing times to provide a seamless user experience.
- Optimize system performance to handle peak loads efficiently.4. Technical Requirements:4.1 Technology Stack:
- Choose appropriate programming languages, frameworks, and databases for development.
- Consider factors such as compatibility, scalability, and security.4.2 API Integration:
- Integrate with World Coin APIs for deposit processing and currency conversion.
- Integrate with M-Pesa APIs for fund transfers and payment processing.4.3 Compliance:
- Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements governing cryptocurrency transactions and financial services in Kenya.5. User Interface (UI) Requirements:5.1 User-Friendly Interface:
- Design an intuitive and user-friendly interface for easy navigation and interaction.
- Ensure compatibility with various devices and screen sizes.5.2 Transaction History:
- Provide users with access to their transaction history for transparency and record-keeping purposes.6. Future Enhancements:
- Consider potential future enhancements such as support for additional cryptocurrencies, integration with other payment gateways, and expansion to other markets beyond Kenya.7. Conclusion:
- This requirements document provides a comprehensive overview of the functionality, technical specifications, and user interface requirements for developing a software solution that enables the conversion of World Coin to Kenyan Shillings using M-Pesa. By adhering to these requirements, the platform aims to provide a seamless and efficient off-ramp for World Coin users in Kenya.

title: Modify Management Module Enhancement Odoo 11 community
description:
Hello,I'm in search of an experienced software developer who can modify and enhance our current shrinkage module, pivoting its functionality for better surplus management.Manufacturing Module WorkflowSelect the desired product to manufacture.Set the quantity to be produced and save the order.Verify the availability of the product for manufacturing.Record the total production.If there is a loss, record the loss.Validate the production order.Changes to be made to the module:Add a button for surplus registration.Surplus: The final production exceeds expectations.Loss: The final production does not meet expectations.The functionality of the button will be the opposite of the loss. When there is a surplus, it should increase the quantity of the final product produced by updating the production yield without affecting the quantities of materials used.*Add a button next to the loss button.Main Requirements:
- Enable us to input the possibility of quantities exceeding 100% in production, meaning if we aim for 100 units and use 100% of the material, it turns out we manage to produce 105, allowing these 5 extra to be entered.-We need to apply an adjustment to our module in order to take control of the surplus. Currently, our system allows us to calculate a shrinkage of finished products. This means that while the material is consumed 100%, it does not manage to produce 100% of the final product due to defects or waste; instead, it only produces 80%. This allows us to close the production process and for the system to accept these differences. We need to apply this in reverse, that is, to use 100% of the raw material but in this case, to produce more than 100% of the finished product.-We can use the same shrinkage workflow, simply reversing it, so to speak. The button should appear as "Surplus" alongside the shrinkage button.Current Scenario: We use a combination of manual and automated tracking to measure production levels.Expected Improvements: We expect important upgrades in our tracking process. The key improvement sought is real-time updating of production levels, offering live updates to manage surpluses effectively at any given moment.Ideal skill set for this project:
- Experience with software development odoo 11- Expertise in automated tracking solutions
- Good understanding of production management systems in odoo 11- Experience with real-time data integration.Regards,Team Softechies Solutions

title: Odds Plug In
description: Im looking for soemone who could create a WP plugin that sits on a website page so people can work out odds on a competition.So they would input - ticket price, number of tickets and this gives them the odds and total value like below -If the ticket price is £34.97 and there are 1999 tickets sold, and assuming the odds are still 2.00 (implying a 50% chance of winning), we'll calculate the chance of winning using the same method.First, let's calculate the total amount collected from selling tickets:Total amount collected = Price per ticket * Number of tickets= £34.97 * 1999≈ £69,899.03Now, let's calculate the potential payout for the winner. Since the odds are 2.00, for every unit bet (£34.97 in this case), the winner would receive £34.97 * 2 = £69.94.The chance of winning is the potential payout divided by the total amount collected:Chance of winning = Potential payout / Total amount collected= (£34.97 * 2) / (£34.97 * 1999)= 2 / 1999≈ 0.0010005To express this as a percentage, multiply by 100:Chance of winning ≈ 0.0010005 * 100≈ 0.10005%So, with the given odds, ticket price, and number of tickets sold, the chance of winning is approximately 0.10005%.

title: Data Analysis
description: Certainly! Data analysis is a process of inspecting, cleaning, transforming, and modeling data with the goal of discovering useful information, drawing conclusions, and supporting decision-making. Here are some key steps and concepts involved in data analysis:1. **Define Objectives:**- Clearly define the goals and objectives of your analysis. What do you want to achieve? What questions are you trying to answer?2. **Data Collection:**- Gather relevant data from various sources. This could be from databases, surveys, sensors, APIs, etc.3. **Data Cleaning:**- Preprocess and clean the data to handle missing values, outliers, and inconsistencies. This step is crucial to ensure the accuracy and reliability of your analysis.4. **Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA):**- Explore the data using descriptive statistics, visualizations, and summary tables to understand its structure, patterns, and relationships. This step helps in generating hypotheses and insights.5. **Data Transformation:**- Transform the data if needed, such as scaling, normalizing, encoding categorical variables, or creating new features.6. **Statistical Analysis:**- Apply statistical methods to test hypotheses, identify patterns, and make inferences about the population based on sample data.7. **Machine Learning:**- Implement machine learning algorithms for predictive modeling or classification tasks, depending on the nature of your analysis.8. **Data Visualization:**- Create visual representations of the data using charts, graphs, and dashboards to communicate insights effectively.9. **Interpretation and Conclusion:**- Draw conclusions from the analysis and interpret the results in the context of your objectives. Communicate findings in a clear and understandable manner.10. **Documentation:**- Document your analysis process, methodologies, and results. This is essential for reproducibility and for others to understand and validate your work.11. **Feedback and Iteration:**- Seek feedback from stakeholders and iterate on your analysis if needed. Continuous improvement is crucial in data analysis.Popular tools for data analysis include Python with libraries like Pandas, NumPy, and Matplotlib, R, and tools like SQL for database queries. Additionally, specialized tools such as Excel, Tableau, and Jupyter Notebooks are commonly used in the field.

title: Schedule Variance and Estimated at Completion Dashboard - Excel = Better planning and forecasting
description: I am seeking a data analyst to develop a sophisticated productivity calculator designed to accurately predict the necessary daily work hours and overall timeline required to complete projects based on various productivity levels and working conditions. The core functionality of this calculator should hinge on analyzing and integrating several key variables: the total project hours needed for completion, the productivity rate of the crew (expressed as a percentage reflecting the actual productive hours out of a standard workday), the size of the crew involved, and the flexibility in working days per week (ranging from a traditional 5-day workweek to extended options of 6 or even 4 days, adjusting for longer or shorter weeks). This tool must adeptly handle the calculation of required daily productive hours for the crew as a whole, taking into account the specified productivity rate, which can vary from 82% (where, for example, out of an 8-hour day, 6.56 hours are effectively productive) to a maximum of 94%. It should provide adjustable parameters for the analyst to simulate different scenarios, such as increasing the workday length to 9 hours or modifying the workweek, and calculate the impact of these adjustments on meeting the project deadline. Crucially, the calculator must offer insights into how changes in daily productivity affect the overall project timeline and suggest optimal working conditions to ensure project completion within the desired timeframe. title: Re-implement StreamDiffusion POC
description: See https://docs.google.com/document/d/1U82LQtQbydvW8vT86GGD8m5-kCdKCZ2rEBD9VlVugUs/edit?usp=sharingIn short:Project OpenDiffusion: Reimplementing and improving stream diffusionWhile the proposed stream diffusion greatly improves speed over other diffusion approaches which makes interactivity and live generation possible, it also severely reduces creative freedom and is constrained to diffusing incoming video. The initial stream diffusion project is also an introduction to a concept, rather than a mature implementation of the potential of the concept. In this project, we aim to reimplement the stream diffusion concepts from the paper into “OpenDiffusion”.In this first POC, we will experiment with different changes to the pipelines to enable more creative freedom at the expense of speed and efficiently, but retain the continuous streaming nature. Additionally, introducing Prompt Arrangement Clips (PAC) as a mechanism to drive changing text prompt input and other controls and variables to steer continuous generation in “dream mode” or otherwise. The implementation re-introduces negative prompts into continuous diffusion.

title: Python Senior Developer for creating documents based on document comparison
description: OverviewWe have a software tool that compares two text documents, referred to as the "left" document and the "right" document. These documents can be in PDF, DOC, or DOCX format. The tool lets users analyze differences and decide whether to accept or reject these changes. After reviewing, users can create a new DOCX file that includes the accepted edits and marks the undecided changes with special tags (like 'w:ins' for added text or 'w:del' for deleted text). This new document starts as a copy of the right document, but it will use text from the left document where changes were not accepted. Any changes not decided upon will appear as open edits in Microsoft Word.What We NeedWe want to make a new tool or script that can take a list of changes (in a file called changeList.json) from our comparison tool and apply those changes correctly in a new third DOCX document, based on what users have accepted or rejected. To keep things straightforward, we will only provide DOCX files for comparison.The changeList.json file records all differences spotted by our tool. Differences include:Match: Text is the same in both documents.Insert: New text appears in the second document.Delete: Text from the first document is missing in the second.Replace: Text from the first document is changed in the second.Here’s an example of what the change list might contain:["kind": "match","text": "Documento"// ... more info here,"kind": "replace","leftText": "S","rightText": "s","status": "pending"// ... more info here// ... more changes listed]Consider any change not marked with status as pendingWhen applying a 'replace' action in the DOCX, it should be formatted like this:[w:del] ... [w:t]S[/w:t] ... [/w:del][w:ins] ... [w:t]s[/w:t] ... [/w:ins]If a user rejects a change, the original text (leftText) takes the place of the changed text (rightText) in the new document. If a change involves deleting text, that text should go back where it was originally, with the same style and format.The ChallengeThe main difficulty lies in transferring these changes into the third document when they involve tables. It's especially hard with tables that have removed rows and columns, or when cells are joined together or there are tables within tables. We'll provide example documents that include these tricky situations to help you understand what needs to be done.There are no strict rules about which technologies you must use, but our system works on Linux containers and we use Python. Your new tool or script must work within this environment. It should be able to run on Linux containers and be callable from Python code.

title: Time Billing / Payroll - Account Software/WebApp (AI Integration)
description:
NOTE: Budget provided is NOT actual budget. We are looking for a team of developers and we understand that this will require a lot of time and effort meaning budget will increase, consider this similar to creating an SaaS.I'm looking for a developer or development team that can create a WebApp/Software that will automate my accounting strategy.I own a labour hire/recruitment company and the method of accounting is as follows:1. Receive timesheets (paper) from employees2. Enter hours of employees into MYOB for payroll3. Pay employees based on their hours and the agreed rate (per hour)4. Create time billing invoices in MYOB with the following columns "NAME", POSITION" , "HOURS", "RATE", "AMOUNT"5. I manually enter the employees name and position, their hours (based on timesheets) and I have a list of 'Activities' for each client to determine how much the rate is based on position and the company. For example, Client A with position Labourer rate would be $30.00/hr, Client B with position Labourer rate could be $35.00/hr.Based on the company the invoice is being created for, the activities (rates) of each position are entered in from the list of activities of each company.6. Invoices are manually emailed out via outlook with the Invoice PDF attached as well as timesheet (scanned) attached.I am trying to find a solution to automate this whole process.I feel like the only manual handling that needs to happen is receiving timesheets from employees then entering the hours into the system. For example, when entering the hours the following will happen:1. Navigate to the employees card (which has all their information including their hourly rate).2. Enter the 'CLIENT' they worked for (customer). i.e. COMPANY ABC PTY LTD3. Enter the 'JOB' they worked at (clients can have multiple jobs and each job can have different activity rates). i.e. 26 Sanders Pde, Concord NSW (jobs are pre-filled in the clients card)4. Enter the 'ACTIVITY' or 'POSITION' of the employee. i.e. Crane Operator (based on the client and job, the positions' rates are entered in a separate list 'Activity List')5. Enter their hours daily based on the timesheet provided (Monday - Sunday).I need a software that will then automatically create a time billing invoice that collates all employees that worked on the same job in one invoice with their information pre-filled (Name, Position, Hours, Rate, Amount.This software will then automatically send out all invoices once they are manually checked over by management (one button send all or send company by company or even job by job via email). The end result is simple, we just need to be able to send all the invoices created for each company via email. Invoice reminders will also be sent out (say if I wanted to remind a client that there are invoices A, B and C due to be paid). I would also like the option to send out account statements to clients on a regular basis with a click of a button (via email, outlook).I also need an option to further make the invoicing more specific (i.e. instead of an invoice for each Clients job, create an invoice for each Clients Job and each position. i.e. all 'Crane Operators' are collated into one invoice for that specific client and job.) However this will only be an option and not automatically generated.To summarise:
- Create 'Cards' for each employee which will house their hourly rate as well as information such as Position, Documents (attach from computer), etc.
- Ability to search employee card, then enter data for employee's hours (Mon-Sun)
- Process Payroll (system automatically calculates employees' pay for the week according to HRS x RATE)
- Once processed, ability to create an .ABA file for Banking information. Ability to use .ABA to pay employees in bulk from. Payroll info is stored and archived
- Time billing Invoices created according to data entered per each employee. Attach paper (scanned) timesheet to invoice.
- Send Invoice with attached timesheet as supported documentation via email to client.Company Cards should house information like official Company Name, Address, Phone, Email, ABN (Australian Business Number), etc. Information is to reflect onto invoices.The description above is quite brief. If I am able to find an entity to create such application, a very detailed deliverables document will be provided with everything expected.Please only apply if you feel you can definitely deliver everything required in an accounting software (or your team is up for the job).

title: Interpert Multi output classification in ML model - R programming
description: Overview:------------Our project involves predicting the next set of 7 Process numbers in a sequence based onhistorical data. We have around 200 data sets each consisting of 49 numbers or values.From each column or each data set, 7 Process numbers are chosen, and our goal is tobuild a machine learning model that predicts these 7 Process numbers for the nextcolumns/dataset.Problem Statement:-------------------The challenge lies in understanding the underlying relationships within the 49 numbers ineach data set, which influence the formation of the 7 pattern numbers of the data set.The relationship or criteria is not definable and explainable. We have to learn bybackpropagation or reverse learning based on the interpretation of the prediction resultsavailable as of now.While our machine learning model has shown promising predictive capabilities, we aim tostrengthen the prediction capabilities by learning the process or calculations or the rulesbased on which the modes are presently giving out correct predictions of 4 to 5 correctnumbers in a prediction of 9 numbers from 49 numbers.For example, in the data set 394. In the test sheet 394-1, with 0.2 test size the SVMLinear classifier model has given out a prediction of 57, 140, 2, 136, 66, 51, 7, 48 and107. Among these 9 numbers, 57, 136, 66 and 7 are correct pattern numbers for the dataset 394.Similarly, in the data set 395, test sheet 394-1A with a test size of 0.2, the Random ForestClassifier model has given out a prediction result of 116, 48, 180, 104, 121, 22, 42, 1 and106. Out of these 9 numbers, 180, 104, 121 and 42 are correct pattern numbers of dataset 395.Next, in the data set 396, the test sheet 396-1 with 0.5 test size the SVM linear classifiermodel has given out a prediction result of 144, 26, 36, 125, 71, 112, 83, 5 and 62. Amongthese nine numbers, 144,112,83,5 and 62 are the correct pattern numbers of the data set396.These models and interpretations are coded by an amateur programmer who is still astudent. I want expert programmers like you to see every aspect of the model and theinterpretation and suggest how I can solve my problem and reach my target. My target isto be able to correctly predict at least 6 numbers correctly among 9 numbers of predictionoutput.

Chiefly, large-scale event data (e.g., Mixpanel, Segment, Snowplow, server logs) and normalized transactional databases (e.g., e-commerce and subscription datasets).• Exposure to large-scale model training in a platform like Spark is helpful but not required.NICE TO HAVES:There are no specific degree requirements for this role: we appreciate and seek out diverse backgrounds. description: I need a Rust-based Soroban smart contracts written. It will do the following:1. A pool smart contract that holds a number of XYZ tokens, established when created. A buy() function that allows the XYZ token to be purchased from the pool for testnet USDC and a sell() function for sending XYZ to pool and getting USDC out. The price XYZ is sold or bought is based on a bonding curve (the math for the bonding will be provided, its based on 6 input factors). Every time a purchase is made, we move the right on the curve, and vice versa for a sell. Each pool has a "treasury" field that holds USDCs. Each pool should have a unique id and a string name.3. A container smart contract that allows for one or more pools. The container smart contract is public and pools are created through the container create_pool() function (i.e. container will have a map or vector of pools), buys / sells go thru the container functions supplying a pool id. Access to a pool directly is not allowedA simple web page that integrates Freighter to create a pool or buy/sell from the poolA simulated version of this can be found here: https://ramm.scifn.comSuccess criteria: Fulfills requirements, able to compile and deploy successfully to Testnet

title: Facial Recognition System with Body Recognition
description: Project Description: Enhancement of Facial Recognition and Body Kinetic Analysis System for Interactive VenuesObjective: We are seeking an experienced machine vision specialist to refine and enhance our current facial recognition and body kinetic analysis system used within interactive gaming venues. Our system is designed to provide a seamless and secure user experience by facilitating user identification and interaction through advanced machine vision technologies.Background: Our venues operate with a unique user registration and identification process. Upon registration, users provide a photograph of themselves along with their driver’s license for KYC validation. This process involves liveliness detection and a match verification between the user’s photograph and their driver’s license image, facilitated by a KYC partner. The user's facial vector representation is then stored in the cloud for subsequent identification at our venues.Current System Overview:User Identification: When a user logs in at a venue, their vector representation is transferred to the local venue's system, which supports up to 100 users concurrently. We utilize infrared (IR) cameras to overcome the challenges posed by bright overhead lighting, which cannot be modified. Our setup includes two cameras per play area, using body location data from both cameras for user positioning and facial matching.Facial Matching: We employ a two-tiered tolerance approach for facial matching:High Tolerance Matching: Used upon entry into the play area under better lighting conditions for initial identification.Low Tolerance (Stricter) Matching: Applied in smaller, more interactive sections of the play area for precise matching.Body Kinetic Analysis: The system is also tasked with collecting body kinetic data during gameplay, focusing on metrics such as shoulder and hip turn, arm position, etc., primarily for golf swing analysis.Challenges and Objectives:Enhance Body Detection and Facial Matching: Improve the accuracy and reliability of human body detection and facial matching, overcoming issues related to poor performance and inaccurate matching.Develop Golf Swing Metric Analysis: Refine and expand the system's capability to analyze body kinetic information, specifically targeting golf swing metrics.Cost and Performance Optimization: Achieve a balance between reducing hardware and software licensing costs and enhancing overall system performance, with a priority on the latter.System Requirements:Experience with IR imaging and overcoming lighting challenges in machine vision applications.Expertise in facial recognition technologies, including liveliness detection and vector representation matching.Proficiency in body kinetic analysis, with a focus on sports metrics (e.g., golf swing analysis).Ability to work with existing systems and potentially integrate or license third-party solutions to meet project objectives.Support and Collaboration: We are committed to providing necessary resources, including sample images and videos, to facilitate the development process. We encourage open communication and inquiry to ensure a comprehensive understanding of our system and objectives.

Products and collections are managed in Shopify and when synced to Sanity provide their data in the store object on their respective document.BoilerplateThe project was built on top of this repository https://github.com/sanity-io/hydrogen-sanity-demo from the Sanity team which provides a good clean example of how our frontend is constructed. This adopts many of Hydrogen's conventions and suggested third-party libraries. We haven’t strayed too far at all from the conventions defined here so this is a great resource.Tailwind CSSUsed predominantly to style the frontend.KLAVIYOKLAVIYO will be the CRM of choice and the frontend uses it for the newsletter signup form. The project takes a headless approach so the two are kept separate.The frontend is hosted on Shopify and the backend is hosted on Vercel.Local DevelopmentNothing of note to add here. Standard development practice to get the apps to run locally (check the package.json for commands available):FrontendTo get started, run npm install to install dependencies. Then run npm run dev to start the local server. To preview builds as you would on production, run npm run preview .BackendTo get started, run npm install to install dependencies. Then run npm run dev to start the local server.DeploymentOnce the Github repos are connected to Vercel and Shopify Oxygen then deployments happen automatically when code is pushed to git.
