title: Facebook/Instagram Marketer
description:
Job Title: Facebook/Instagram Marketing Specialist for Fitness StudioJob Overview:We are a dynamic fitness studio located within a focused 10-mile radius, dedicated to transforming lives through fitness. Our mission is to inspire, motivate, and guide our community towards a healthier lifestyle. We are seeking a full-time, experienced Facebook/Instagram Marketer to join our team.This role is ideal for someone passionate about crafting compelling campaigns, eager to implement innovative ideas, and skilled in enhancing our digital presence to drive membership and engagement. The ideal candidate will work closely with our team to bring our vision to life, optimizing our social media advertising efforts for the highest returns.Responsibilities:
- Collaborate directly with the studio owner to understand the business goals, marketing objectives, and creative direction.
- Design, implement, and manage Facebook/Instagram ad campaigns specifically tailored to our local market within a 10-mile radius.
- Bring innovative marketing ideas and strategies to the table, while effectively implementing and testing the owner's creative concepts.Create and edit ad creatives, including images and videos, to produce multiple variations for A/B testing, optimizing for engagement and conversion.
- Monitor, analyze, and report on campaign performance, adjusting strategies based on data-driven insights to maximize ROI.
- Manage the studio's Facebook/Instagram ad budget efficiently, ensuring optimal allocation for the best results.
- Stay updated on the latest trends and best practices in social media marketing to keep our campaigns cutting edge.
- Provide regular updates and clear communication to the studio owner on campaign progress and results.Requirements:
- Proven experience as a Facebook/Instagram Marketer, with a strong portfolio of successful social media campaigns, preferably in the fitness industry or related fields.
- Expert knowledge of Facebook Ads Manager and Instagram advertising platforms.
- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, dedicated to our studio's campaigns without being distracted by multiple client commitments.
- Creative skills in designing and editing ad creatives to produce compelling visual content.
- Strong analytical skills to interpret campaign data and make informed decisions for optimization.
- Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal, are mandatory.
- Willingness to participate in a Zoom interview process.
- A positive, collaborative attitude and a strong work ethic are essential.Must speak fluent EnglishHow to Apply:Please submit your application including:
- A cover letter detailing your experience in Facebook/Instagram marketing and why you are a good fit for this role.Your resume/CV.
- A portfolio of your previous work/campaigns, including any relevant results that demonstrate your capability to succeed in this role.Availability for a Zoom interview.
- We are looking forward to hearing from passionate and skilled marketers who are ready to help our fitness studio soar to new heights. Join us in making a significant impact on our community's health and fitness journey.

We are a dynamic and rapidly growing Formula 1 YouTube channel dedicated to providing high-quality, engaging, and informative content to racing enthusiasts worldwide. - Proven experience as a Video Editor, with a strong portfolio showcasing previous work in video editing, preferably in the sports or automotive industry.
- Proficiency in video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or DaVinci Resolve.
- Excellent storytelling skills with the ability to craft compelling narratives through video editing.
- A deep understanding of Formula 1 racing and its nuances, including knowledge of current drivers, teams, and races.
- Strong attention to detail and a meticulous approach to editing to ensure the highest level of quality in the final product.
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment, juggling multiple projects and deadlines effectively.
- Strong communication skills with the ability to take constructive feedback and collaborate with team members to achieve shared goals.Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience working with motion graphics software such as Adobe After Effects or Cinema 4D.
- Familiarity with YouTube's content guidelines, optimization techniques, and best practices for driving engagement and audience growth.
- Passion for Formula 1 racing and a genuine interest in staying updated on the latest news, developments, and trends in the sport.Compensation:
- Initial fee of £350 per month for editing 15 videos, payable on a freelance basis.
- Profit share bonus of up to £350 per video, based on performance metrics such as views, engagement, and audience retention.
- Maximum potential monthly return of £5600, inclusive of base compensation and profit share bonuses.If you are a skilled Video Editor with a passion for Formula 1 racing and a knack for creating engaging and well-edited videos, we would love to hear from you! Please submit your resume, portfolio, and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience and why you would be the perfect fit for this role.

title: Redesign several pages of an event management web tool

- CSS/HTML/Code to be written— design files will be fine

Layout, spacing, colors. and overall UX is more helpful to me.I’m shooting to get this polished enough for production and ready for the first event coordinator I’m working with, but this job could be open ended. If your work is good I will certainly be adding features that will need better design than I can give it.Staging site is available to be clicked through once we get further into the process. Attached are screenshots from various existing pages that will need work.

title: Setup a Docker based reverse proxy+WAF+ssl with 3 CMS containers
description:
Hello, I have a web server that keeps getting infected by warms... its on Apache with php,mysql on Debian. No matter what I do viruses keep infecting neighboring sites (vhosts) and things at this point are beyond repair. So I've been advised to go the docker way with a reverse proxy with WAF in front the website containers and it sounds promising.Important:I do not want the job just done once but to know how to set it up myself in case everything goes south...If I have to summarize - I need a step by step tutorial how to turn brand new Ubuntu server into this (as follows):1 Docker container - proxy (nginx) + waf like in this tutorial (https://medium.com/cloud-native-daily/dockerized-mod-security-waf-c3e7233be002) + Certbot or other auto ssl solution with cronjob.3 more containers as follows1 wordpress (latest)1 joomla (latest)1 drupal (latest)
- Static IP's on the containers
- Php on each container to be at least 8.0- Bash on every container
- SSH with unique port on the host machine forwarding to each container,- Phpmyadmin on every container,- Files from each container's www directory have to be mapped to a host machine folder in order to be preserved in the case of rebuilding the container. - here I have a little dejavu with the cross-contamination of my current setup, so if not a good idea to pup files from different sites close to eachother, then we can skip this setup and I'll think of a regular file backupIf you have any suggestions to better the idea explained in the beginning - please do so.I may have asked stupid stuff above as I am new to how Docker works and what can or can not be done... so please feel free to correct me so the job requirement becomes more clear. I just want to have a working set of web servers in separate container behind reverse proxy+WAF+ssl to avoid breaching or cross-contamination in the event of a breach.I hope all this makes sense.Bonus: ? http://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_limit_req_module.html

title: Write a 10 minute enganging speech about a Ukrainian / Belorusian film in SLOVAK
description:
Sme charitatívna umelecká komunita, ktorá sa v súčasnosti zameriava na premietanie zahraničných filmov. Ako predohru k filmovým projekciám plánujeme vytvoriť informačnú prednášku, ktorá pomôže "naservírovať" film divákovi a poskytne potrebné súvislosti o výrobe filmu, informácie o živote producenta, kontexte vzniku filmu, ako aj o tom, prečo film vyniká.(Planujeme 6 premietani do konca aprila takze 6 prac takeho typu)Toto zadanie je pre film: FRAGILE MEMORY // КРИХКА ПАМ'ЯТЬNa realizáciu projektu by bolo dobré mať nasledujúce zručnosti:
- Základné znalosti o filme (Text by nemal byť akademickou analýzou, ale ani príliš základnou, mal by byť pútavý pre diváka s mierne nadpriemernou úrovňou filmových skúseností. Nie článok z wikipédie - mal by sprostredkovať všetky potrebné zaujímavé informácie tak, aby nevyznievali nútene)
- Písanie poloformálnym štýlom ( Diváci sú väčšinou mladí a prichádzajú za zážitkom do spoločnosti, dôležitá je dobrá znalosť tónu a pridanie humoru a pridanie "prízemných" opisov zložitejších tém.
- Dobré rešeršné zručnosti (Niektoré filmy sú nezávislou zahraničnou produkciou a môžu si vyžadovať viac prezerania (a možno aj prekladu a overovania faktov) ako zvyčajne, aby ste sa dostali ku všetkým informáciám.
- Znalosť angličtiny a slovenčiny (ideálne aj ukrajinčiny alebo ruštiny) Keďže naše filmy sú vo väčšine prípadov zahraničné (neslovenské a neanglické), ďalšia znalosť iných jazykov by bola veľmi užitočná.Potrebujeme mať úvod, nie veľmi formálny, urobiť z toho trošku narrativny rozhovor o filme.Plánujeme robiť viacero takých premietaní a potrebujeme tento text ku každej. Čo sa týka dostupnosti filmu, vieme vám zabezpečiť jeho pozretie prostredníctvom stránky dafilms.com Tam sa dá za 2,50 pozrieť tieto filmy, viem to prirátať k cene alebo ponúknuť pozriete cez naše konto.Materiály ku filmu čiže články atď priamo k dispozícii nemáme, je to súčasť tasku urobiť rešerš o filme a režisére.O nás:Naše združenie sa snaží prostredníctvom filmov ukázať kultúru vybranej krajiny - cez oči ľudí odtiaľ. Je to hlavná pointa celého projektu. Aby ľudia si pochopili čo to pre tých ľudí znamená byť X kultúrou, a na akých problémoch im záleží alebo na aké dávajú dôraz.Zohľadniť tento cieľ projektu v rámci textu by bolo vhodné.Naše združenie sa venuje rôznorodým kultúrnym aktivitám a podujatiam pre cudzincov na Slovensku. Podporujeme aj charitu a z každého podujatia prispievame na humanitárne fondy. Snažíme sa ukázať silu umenie ako prostriedku na boj proti násiliu. Že každý umelec alebo fanúšik umenia vie tým odkomunikovať svoju pozíciu, prispieť k interkulturnemu dialógu a predísť aj predsudkam.Sme organizácia mladých ľudí a naši podujatia majú väčšinou komunitný aspekt, bez zvýšenej oficialnosti, a komunikácia je hravá a snažíme rozprávať voľnejším jazykom ako ste správne napísali. Táto "lekcia" by mala mať charakter rozprávania divákovi o filme a o okolitých informáciách. Chceme stále aby ťa lekcia mala prínos pre človeka ktorého zaujíma film ale aj pre obyčajného diváka. Proste nechceme robiť zo seba vedcov ale ani nechceme aby to bolo príliš zjednodušene. Hľadáme nejaký stred.Dúfam že tieto informácie vám pomôžu lepšie pochopiť o čom je náš projekt a naša organizácia celkovo :))

title: AI and WordPress: Standardize 10,000+ Existing Recipes on Food Website
description:
Background:We operate a well-established food website featuring around 15,000 recipes uploaded by various contributors. Currently, our recipes are inconsistent in format due to multiple migrations between different WordPress recipe plugins, leading to corruption and missing information. The website attracts hundreds of thousands of visitors each month and is a valuable resource for food enthusiasts. We aim to standardize and optimize all recipes to improve user experience and enhance SEO performance. The project involves data normalization, AI-powered content generation, and automation within WordPress.Scope of Work:1. Data Assessment and Cleanup:
- Analyze the current database to identify inconsistencies and missing information across different recipe formats.
- Develop a strategy for data normalization to standardize recipe formats.
- Clean up the database to ensure all recipes adhere to the new standardized format, including titles, ingredients, cooking times, and other essential details.2. AI Integration and Content Generation:
- Integrate AI tools with WordPress to automate the filling in of missing recipe information, rewrite recipe steps for clarity, and ensure all content is SEO optimized.
- Develop or implement an existing AI model tailored for culinary content to update recipes.
- Ensure the AI-generated content maintains a natural and engaging tone, adhering to culinary best practices.3. Automation and WordPress Integration:
- Implement automated processes for updating and uploading all recipes to the WordPress platform, ensuring consistency and accuracy, as well as making sure no content is broken.
- Customize or configure WordPress plugins (such as WP All Import or WP Ultimate CSV Importer) to facilitate bulk updates and imports.
- Ensure all recipes meet SEO standards.4. Quality Assurance and Testing:
- Conduct thorough testing of the updated recipes and the automation processes to ensure accuracy and user satisfaction.
- Establish a feedback loop for continuous improvement of the content updating process.5. Documentation and Training:
- Provide comprehensive documentation on the implemented processes and systems.Qualifications:
- Proven experience in WordPress development and customization.
- Strong background in AI integration and content generation within WordPress.
- Familiarity with SEO best practices and tools.
- Experience in data analysis and cleanup projects.
- Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
- Ability to work independently and efficiently to meet deadlines.Deliverables:
- A fully automated system for updating and standardizing recipes on the WordPress platform.
- All recipes fully SEO optimized within the context of the recipe standardization.
- Documentation and training materials for maintaining the system.

The spacing between the 15 stars needs to be universal/the same.Bird: double check accuracy, we have not modified the bird or the wheat in its left hand. Double check shape of mountain and peak is accurate, it’s what gives Mt Hood its name.Sun: The sun has been moved from the placement on the Oregon flag to the top of the center. Please recreate the sun and its rays to match the OR flag style, but keep sun in current location.Trees: The trees on the felt have been moved from the right side of the Oregon emblem and duplicated to fill space. Double check the moved trees for accuracy and add more to fill it out as it shows in our design.Banner with “Job Done Right”: Banner should be accurate; the slogan is our own.“Environmental Works” text and “2009” are in the style of Oregon flag, we have changed the scale to make the full company name fit and decreased the size of the date. Please just recreate from the design.___Items not from the flag were made by me, to represent our business and what we offer. Some of them I want to remain the same, most I want modifications or artistic updates for.Items from our business/made by me:Bird’s items: Spade, pipe wrench, wrench. Keep as is, unless you can make the three read better. The arrows on the original are small, so we need to stick to that scale.Columbia River: A simple design that “passes under” the banner. Keep island in the center and feel free to make modifications that would represent the Columbia River more accurately, or leave as is.Excavator: Please redraw to fit the style and to add some perspective. I like the bucket style but the body needs a professional touch.Shovel and dig site: Redraw if needed. Keep the soil mounds visible in some way, it connects the excavator, Heating Oil Tank, and dump truck all together.Heating Oil Tank: Move if need be, keep design as is.Dump Truck: Redraw. I like the style generally, but I think an expert could finish it better.Radon System (with house): Modify house if needed, keep Radon System fan as designed.Wrench: Feel free to redrawHard Hat: Please redraw. I like the scale but my art is not the best.Mostly I just want a re-finishing of the emblem that I’ve sent over. Our team knew it’d be a packed design so we wanted to get all of the brainstorming out of the way and focus on beautifying the output.If you want to make creative modifications, please chat with me about them! Even though I’m pretty set on the design I have an open mind to collaboration!

title: Back and forward test trading bot
description: Will need the following. With reports to confirm the potential of the trading bot. May require more than one to be checked.Backtesting:Collect Historical Data: Obtain historical price data for the cryptocurrency pairs you want to trade. Binance provides historical data through their API or you can use third-party sources.Implement Trading Strategy: Modify your trading bot code to run in a backtesting environment. Instead of fetching real-time data, simulate the trading decisions based on historical data.Set Up Backtesting Framework: Create a framework to simulate trades based on historical data. This can involve iterating through historical data, applying your trading strategy, and keeping track of simulated trades and portfolio value.Run Backtest: Execute the backtesting framework with your modified trading bot code. Monitor the bot's performance, including metrics such as profit/loss, win rate, drawdown, and Sharpe ratio.Analyze Results: Analyze the results of the backtest to evaluate the performance of your trading bot. Identify strengths and weaknesses, and consider making adjustments to the trading strategy or parameters based on the insights gained.Forward Testing:Set Up Paper Trading Account: Create a paper trading account on Binance or use their API sandbox environment. This will allow you to trade with virtual funds in real-time market conditions without risking real money.Deploy Trading Bot: Deploy your trading bot in the paper trading environment. Ensure that it's connected to the paper trading account and configured to execute trades using virtual funds.Monitor Performance: Monitor the performance of your trading bot in the paper trading environment. Keep track of trades executed, portfolio value, and performance metrics.Evaluate Results: Evaluate the performance of your trading bot in the paper trading environment. Compare its performance to the results of the backtest and identify any discrepancies or issues.Optimize and Refine: Based on the results of forward testing, optimize and refine your trading bot as necessary. This may involve tweaking parameters, adjusting the trading strategy, or implementing additional risk management techniques.Gradual Deployment: Once you're confident in the performance of your trading bot in the paper trading environment, you can consider deploying it with a small amount of real funds in a live trading environment on Binance.

title: iOS application like VPN(proxy)
description: We have bot developer and he has developed a bot in a niche space and he is currently working on improving accessibility for users. I am trying to develop a small iOS app that proxies network request to retrieve user credentials (via the headers of an HTTPS request) from another iOS app.Based on my testing, I confirmed this is possible by installing a CA profile (cacert.pem file) on the iOS device and giving it full trust. By proxying via mitmproxy with that certificate, it is possible to see all contents of HTTPS requests. I have already written the code (Swift iOS app) to host/install the CA Profile on the iOS device, but my exposure to Swift is limited, so I am looking for some help with developing the infrastructure to proxy/decrypt the network requests.There are some rough examples online of adjacent tools (Swift NIO/SSL) or incomplete examples (https://forums.swift.org/t/capture-packets-using-man-in-the-middle-mitm-proxy/53650).

title: Marketplace Purchase Automation (Bypass Cloudflare)
description: I have a Puppeteer script that combines with a private google chrome extension (to avoid Cloudflare detection) to automate the purchase of newly listed items on an online marketplace if certain values are met.The Process:Script reads newly listed items via websocket API, if the newly listed item(s) matches the filters I have set - the script will attempt to purchase them. The script adds the items to the cart, redirects to the checkout page, the payment form appears, and then attempts order creation via web request. During order creation, the script solves the Cloudflare turnstile to send the request.Current Problem:Bypassing Cloudflare and generating a valid token, the marketplace is currently detecting the generated token as they depend on other values, parameters, or requests which are uncertain. The token should be provided as a parameter on the order creation payload for the website to create the order. The script currently bypasses the Cloudflare turnstile, but it is likely the issue is not related to the turnstile part as the script can already generate the token with no issue, it's about other parameters or requests.Currently this process methodology is very slow, it takes the script roughly 5-6 seconds to complete a successful order. I am looking for a solution that can create orders in around 1.5 seconds or less. Understanding their latest logic and finding a way to generate the token while not being flagged by captcha is likely the priority to achieve these results.

title: Excel VPA Programming help required for small project
description:
I want to develop a very small system for my music teaching classes. Currently I have to open a student's excel file & copy what they did in their class last week to a master file.I refer to the master file during class - ticking things off as the student completes an item. When the class is over, I then have to copy & paste their row(s) from the master file back into their individual student file.In class I use an android tablet - but after that everything would be PC windows based.This is very repetitive and I would like to automate the process.I program myself but simply don't have the time to do this properly myself.Here is a basic flow of how things could be done:----------------------------------------------------------Take a list of names from a column in excel.For each name in the list:
- Open an excel file with the same name
- Take the last 2 rows of content and add these to a master file.--------------------------------------------------Reverse process:From a master file:
- Take 2 rows at a time - using a name in the 1st cell
- Open an excel file with this name
- Add the 2 rows to this file & delete from master file------------------------------------------------------------------There is more I would like to add to this, but it would be great to get this much working first. :)

title: Basic pinescript indicator for tradingview
description: Need a very basic indicator for tradingviewMainly im looking for wick to body ratio of the last “x” number of candles. Usually the ATR calculates the range from high to low of candles and averages the last “x” number of candles but what im looking for it should calculate the wicks and the body separately then divide wicks by body to come up with a ratio. The ratio of the last “x” number of candles is what im looking for.For example, a bullish candleOpen 1.0050High 1.0090Low 1.0030Close 1.0080Normally the atr would take the difference between high and low which in this case is 60 pips. It does the same for the previous “x” number of candles and gives an average range.But what i need is to calculate the difference between the upper body (closing price for a bullish candle) and the high. Equals to 10 pips. Then it calculates the difference between lower body (opening price for bullish candle) and the low. Equals to 20 pips. Add this 10+20 pips= 30 this is the “wick size of the candle”. After this we take the difference between the upper and lower body which is the difference between open and close prices. 1.0050 and 1.0080 so its 30 pips. This is the “body size of the candle”.We now divide wick size by the body size. 30/30 and the ratio is 1.00. So we do the same process for the last x number of candles and calculate the average ratio.Other stuff:1. The “x” is going to be an input parameter. If i choose it to be 15 it will calculate wick to body ratio of last 15 candles and give me an average2. You will need to help me setup in my tradingview in case i run into troubles3. The indicator should be easy to build once u understand what im trying to do4. Price is fixed. No negotiation
